name: agent-keychain
description: Lets a coding agent top up its own API credits when it runs low, using Stripe Link for payment — no Stripe account or API keys required.

skills.name: topup
skills.description: Request a Stripe Link card to top up an API provider's credits. Triggered automatically on quota/credit errors, or manually with /topup.

data_files.description: Registry of supported API providers, billing URLs, and error patterns.
